title: Kusanagi Nene — Trying On Cuteness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Meow Park

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who would've guessed that a cat would take us around the carnival...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? On top of already being completely surrounded by cats, we got to meet a real one...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, where do you think he's taking us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No idea! We'll just have to follow Nyantaro until... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's wrong, Nyantaro? Why'd you stop...?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
This looks like a souvenir shop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, are you telling us to buy some merchandise before going on any rides...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha!
Talk about a deft salesman.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wanna check it out...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm game♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. I mean, I was already planning on buying some stuff.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... Yes, they have quite the selection here. And the cat theming remains impeccable!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, they're all really cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Check it out!
Aren't these sunglasses adorable?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, the lenses are shaped like cats...!
That seems pretty fashionable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It'd be so much fun to walk around wearing a pair of these!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What if you paired those with a cat tail?
They've got so many different types here! Striped tails, fluffy tails, everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
They also have a wide selection of T-shirts!
This one has an overwhelmingly large cat's face printed on it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know! I should take this opportunity to fully deck myself out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I'd really rather you didn't stand out too much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, they do have a ton of stuff here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
But I think these are in order since we're at a cat-themed carnival.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Cat ear headbands!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They have a ton of different types. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
These other headbands have little cat characters on them!
Aren't they just the cutest?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they really are!
There's a black and white one, a tortoiseshell one, a calico... Talk about a wide variety!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... Choosing just one is difficult...
But I think I'll go with one of the tabbies to match Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This one's even making a dignified expression!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, does this mean we're all gonna be wearing one of these...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Y-Yeah, they are cute...
But that also sounds kind of embarrassing...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You had a complicated look on your face just now while looking at these headbands. I was wondering if something was wrong...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, umm... It just sounded like we're all gonna be wearing these.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not against that or anything, but these seem a bit too cutesy for me is all...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really...? I think these would suit you really well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you don't have to if you don't feel comfortable, Kusanagi. It's important that you get to enjoy this carnival the way you like.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Look at me!
I wanted to try on the tortoiseshell!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
I also picked out a T-shirt!
How does this look? I think it suits me rather well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, you two look awesome!
Oh, but these might look even better on you guys...
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should enjoy this carnival the way I like...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Momoi's such a nice person.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh... This headband is really cute...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(And no one's looking right now...
Now's my chance to try it on... Alright, where's the mirror...?)
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This really is adorable...)
se_walk_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
That headband looks great on you, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, if you like it, then why not buy it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? No, I was just trying it on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... You're right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It might be fun to buy something like this for a change...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I believe we're all set to go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah! So, let's take these up front.
C'mon, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...!
